text:
Maria: @oncall infra-bot fired a cluster alert for rack-rw-13 (us-west2) — sudden PCIe AER spike and intermittent NVLink link flaps. Seeing throughput drop ~12% on p99. Xid 126 and 31 in logs. Anyone oncall?

infra-bot: ALERT: AER_ERRORS_HIGH on rack-rw-13. Affected hosts: rw13-n01 rw13-n02 rw13-n03 rw13-n04 rw13-n05. Metric: nvlink_link_down_count spiked 55 -> 340 in 10m.

Kevin: confirmed. dmesg shows "AER: Multiple Uncorrected error(s) detected" and nvlink reports "link down (err count)" on rw13-n03 and rw13-n04. We pushed nvidia driver 525.60 last night; could be correlated.

Ajay: quick triage ask — can someone paste `dmesg | grep -i -E "AER|Xid|nvlink"` from rw13-n03? Also check `nvidia-smi -q` for ECC counts.

Maria: paste from rw13-n03 below:
```
[ 12345.678] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:03:00): 126, PID=4321, GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 12345.679] AER: corrected error, vendor_id=10de device_id=1e07
[ 12346.020] nvlink: nvlink0: link0 down, err_count=12
[ 12346.021] NVRM: GPU 0000:03:00:00: Uncorrectable ECC error on DRAM
```

Sasha: ECC correctables are rising on GPU1/GPU2 as well. I recommend draining affected GPUs and running a riser swap before RMA. Which exact GPU slot list are we draining?

Kevin: propose drain list: rw13-n03:gpu0, rw13-n03:gpu1, rw13-n04:gpu0, rw13-n05:gpu2, rw13-n01:gpu3, rw13-n02:gpu0 (6 GPUs). Impact: ~7% capacity loss in us-west2 for batch/inference. Options: shift low-priority jobs to dedicated us-east pool or allow short-lived spot spin-up in eu-west — cost delta estimate ~+$1.2k/day if we keep tails on CPU fallback or cross-region GPU.

Ajay: do rolling drains one node at a time. I'll start with rw13-n03 now. @oncall please ack so we don't overlap with any scheduled rollouts. :eyes:

infra-bot: ACTION: started kube drain on rw13-n03 (cordon & evict). Pod disruption budget respected. TTL: 15m. Watch for pending pods.

Maria: noted — I'll open vendor RMA with the serials and tag the removed cards. Before RMA we'll try riser swap on rw13-n04 to see if NVLink errors follow the card or stay with slot. Also keep logs for Xid 31/126 and attach to ticket.

Kevin: added a short-lived dashboard + alert (nvlink_error_rate > 5/min) and a monitoring runbook snippet. PR created to adjust threshold. Will follow up with cost impact calc in #capacity later. :thumbsup:
